authority_source.directive: Chốt theo logic kinh doanh thông thường và tiếp tục
authority_source.authenticity_note: This records the actual user directive. It does not authorize a production deployment, paid cloud mutation, or use of live provider credentials.

rationale: Object storage prevents videos and invoices from being tied to one API container or ephemeral disk.
An S3-compatible contract remains provider-neutral and supports low-cost MVP hosting as well as later multi-instance scaling.
A single API replica is the initial staging and controlled-pilot default to minimize cost and operational complexity.
Managed PostgreSQL and Redis reduce backup, patching, and availability burden for a small business team.
Local filesystem remains available only for development and isolated tests.
conditions: Do not call a real S3 or cloud provider account.
Do not use or print real access keys, bucket names, customer data, learner media, or invoices.
Use synthetic uploads and disposable local MinIO or mocked adapters only.
Preserve authorization, MIME/size validation, path traversal denial, redaction, audit, and cleanup behavior.
Keep live providers and production disabled.
Require a separate hosted-staging account/domain/secret authorization before external deployment.
